info.title: Kids Coding Platform API
info.description: One API for the student and parent web app, the admin panel, the marketing site and the Flutter app. Every route checks the caller’s role.

type.description:
badge_earned, certificate_issued, payment_receipt, payment_failed, plan_ended,
trial_ending, child_shipped or child_certificate.

data.description: Keys and IDs the message needs, e.g. { "badgeKey": "first-ship" }.

token.description: The phone's Firebase Cloud Messaging token.

language.description: The app's language (en, ar or ur): notifications are written in it.

status.description: Always "ok" while the process is running.

email.description: The parent's email address. It becomes their login.

password.description: At least 10 characters. A short sentence is easy to remember and hard to guess.

displayName.description: How we greet the parent. Never shown publicly.

languageCode.description: Language for emails and the app, e.g. "en", "ar", "ur".

acceptTerms.description: Must be true: the parent accepts the terms and privacy policy.

referralCode.description: The code from another family's invite link (…/sign-up?ref=CODE); unknown codes are ignored.

status.description: Always "accepted". The response is the same whether or not the email is registered.

token.description: The token from the email link.
The token from the email link.

tokenDelivery.description:
How to hand over the refresh token. Browsers use "cookie" (the default): an
httpOnly cookie scripts can't read. The mobile app uses "body" and keeps it in
secure storage.

app.description:
Which app is signing in. The admin panel keeps its own refresh cookie, so a
staff session and a parent session in the same browser never overwrite each
other, and only staff can sign in to it. The mobile app is for students and
parents only, and always gets its refresh token in the body.

twoFactorEnabled.description: Whether two-factor login is switched on (staff only).

mustAcceptTerms.description: Parents: the terms changed since they last accepted them (ask before going on).

student.description: Students only: what other children see.

rules.description:
The caller's permission rules in CASL format, so apps can hide what the API
would refuse anyway. The API always re-checks.

status.description:
authenticated = signed in. mfa_required = send the authenticator code to
/v1/auth/mfa/verify. mfa_setup_required = staff account without two-factor yet:
call /v1/auth/mfa/setup, then /v1/auth/mfa/verify.

expiresIn.description: Seconds until the access token expires.

mfaToken.description: Short-lived token for the two-factor step.

username.description: The login name the parent received, e.g. "swift-falcon-4821".

tokenDelivery.description:
How to hand over the refresh token. Browsers use "cookie" (the default): an
httpOnly cookie scripts can't read. The mobile app uses "body" and keeps it in
secure storage.

staff session and a parent session in the same browser never overwrite each
other, and only staff can sign in to it. The mobile app is for students and
parents only, and always gets its refresh token in the body.

pictures.description: Four picture keys in the order the child tapped them.

httpOnly cookie scripts can't read. The mobile app uses "body" and keeps it in
secure storage.

other, and only staff can sign in to it. The mobile app is for students and
parents only, and always gets its refresh token in the body.
Which app shows the code (the mobile app keeps its tokens itself).

code.description: Shown on the child's device (and in its QR code), e.g. "K7MQ-4XPR".

secret.description: Only the device that asked holds it: it proves the device when claiming.

mfaToken.description: The short-lived token returned by login when a second step is needed.

secret.description: Base32 secret, for typing into an authenticator app by hand.

otpauthUrl.description: otpauth:// link; show it as a QR code.

code.description: The 6-digit code from the authenticator app.

version.description: The version the parent read (TERMS_VERSION), e.g. "2026-10".

reason.description: Why there was no reward: SAME_NETWORK, SAME_FAMILY, YEARLY_LIMIT, NO_CHILDREN, REFERRER_GONE.

link.description: The invite link: the sign-up page with the code.

rewardDays.description: Premium days each child gets per rewarded invitation.

rewardedThisYear.description: Rewarded invitations in the last 365 days.

displayName.description: Adults: their name. Students: their nickname.

reason.description: Why — kept in the audit log.

minXp.description: XP at which this level starts.

nextMinXp.description: XP at which the next level starts; null at the top level.

xp.description: XP earned today, in the student's time zone.

goalXp.description: The daily goal behind the streak.

capXp.description: Most XP that counts in one day.

current.description: Days in a row with the goal met (0 once a day is missed without a freeze).

freezes.description: Streak freezes held (each covers one missed day).

freezesNeeded.description: Freezes that meeting today's goal will use (days missed since the last goal).

key.description: ISO week, e.g. "2026-W40". Boards reset at Monday 00:00 in the student's time zone.

endDay.description: The next Monday, when the board resets.

hidden.description: True when the family keeps the student off public leaderboards.

regionRank.description: Null until the region's board is open (enough students) or no region is set.

endDay.description: The day after the last day; null while the end isn't planned.

season.description: The season staff are running, if any.

endDay.description: When the board resets (Monday 00:00, the student's time).

areaName.description: The region's or city's name, for those boards.

available.description:
False when there is nothing to show: no season running, no region or city set, or
fewer than `minStudents` students there on public boards.

endDay.description: The day after the week (it ends at Monday 00:00, the student's time; results come by Monday 00:00 UTC).

zone.description: Where this place goes if the week ended now: up a league, down, or neither.

nickname.description:
Null for a student whose parent keeps them off public boards (shown as "A player"),
unless it's the viewer or one of their friends.

tier.description: The league the student played that week in.

newTier.description: The league they are in now.

joined.description: False until the student earns XP this week (that puts them in a group).

standings.description: The group, best first. Empty until joined.

promoteCount.description: How many move up and down when the week closes (in a group this size).

lastResult.description: Last week's result, until the student has seen it.

seen.description: False for badges earned but not celebrated yet.

periodKey.description: The period shown, e.g. "2026-W40" (UTC week), a season ID or "all".

areaSize.description: Students on public boards there (region and city boards need `minStudents`).

endDay.description: Planned end: the day after the last day.

manual.description: True for badges staff give by hand (they can take these back).

amount.description: XP to take away (at most the student's total).

reason.description: Why, e.g. "Submitted copied answers in bulk". Kept in the audit log and XP history.

nativeName.description: Name in the language itself, e.g. "اردو"

publicLeaderboards.description: Show the child (nickname and avatar only) on city, country and global leaderboards.

publicPortfolio.description: Let anyone with the link see the child's finished projects.

status.description: PENDING_CONSENT: under 13 and waiting for the parent's verified consent.

hasPicturePassword.description: The child can sign in with a picture password (set by the parent).

premiumUntil.description: When today's premium ends (a plan renews on its own); null without premium.

premiumSource.description: Where premium comes from: the family's plan, our team, or the free trial.

trialEndsAt.description: The child's free trial (over or not).

streak.description: Days in a row with the daily goal met (0 once a day is missed).

streakReminders.description: Evening reminders in the mobile app when the streak is about to end.

birthYears.description: Birth years a parent may choose right now.

under13Open.description: Whether accounts for children under 13 are open.

under13Methods.description: How parents in the parent's country can give verified consent for under-13s.

nickname.description: Shown to other children. Letters, digits and _; never the child's real name.

birthYear.description: Only the year is stored, never the full date of birth.

languageCode.description: Language the child learns in, e.g. "ur".

password.description: Chosen by the parent; the child logs in with it.

streakReminders.description: Evening reminders on the child's phone when their streak is about to end.

finishedAt.description: When the client accepted the work.

allowed.description: True while "Public projects" is on: only then can the portfolio be shared.

token.description: The secret part of the share link, or null when there is no link.

py.description: Python lessons: the program (runs with Pyodide in the sandbox).

blocks.description: Explorer lessons: the block program, as JSON (see packages/checks, stage).

git.description: Git lessons: the steps taken in the practice repository, as JSON (packages/checks, git).

map.description: Rows, top to bottom: "#" wall, "." floor, "S" start, "G" flag, "*" gem, "T" star.

toolbox.description: The blocks in the toolbox, in order.

title.description: The project's title, in the requested language.

files.description: The shipped files, to show in the sandbox.

stage.description: Block projects: the level the program plays on.

review.description: The latest mentor review (for the student and parents; never on the public page).

pictures.description: Four picture keys in order (see PICTURE_KEYS), or null to remove the picture password.

nickname.description: Type the child's nickname to confirm.

language.description: The language the texts are in (English when a translation is missing).

files.description: The editor tabs, in order: index.html, style.css, script.js.

checks.description: What the project needs before it can ship (see packages/checks).

hints.description: Hint texts by key, in the requested language with English filling gaps.

checkLabels.description: What each check looks at, by check ID, in the requested language (English fills gaps).

draft.description: The student's saved code, if any.

version.description: The portfolio version shipped last (1, 2, …), or null.

review.description: The latest mentor review of this project (premium), or null.

results.description: What the requirement checks in the browser sandbox found.

shipped.description: False when a requirement isn't met yet: nothing was published.
